title: Macro-program pipeline — catalog + safety-gated fill + per-machine emit + bulk fan-out
rationale: User 2026-05-12: 'add the corresponding macro program to each file system that has a part that could use one of the programs; check existing programs for each part then make a version of each program utilizing one of the macro programs; make a program for each lathe machine and label it for each machine; coding must match controller and machine capabilities'. Spec was scoped by claude-8f2683e8 (slot charlie) per the forge methodology with the live system-viz graph as dependency oracle. Key finding: ~80% of this pipeline already exists (OkumaParametricProgramEngine, MacroProgramIntelligenceEngine, OkumaMacroHeaderGeneratorEngine, LatheProofCarryingEmitEngine, LathePrintProgramEmitterEngine, ShopConfigurationEngine, LathePartClassifierEngine, PartFolderOrganizerEngine, etc). Milestone is mostly WIRING + a thin orchestrator + the 2 missing macro families + the bulk fan-out — NOT a from-scratch build. U2-U6 are SAFETY-CRITICAL (auto-emitting G-code from print dims) and gated by S(x) >= 0.70 + envelope check + sim + operator sign-off. NEVER bulk-auto-emit G-code. U1 is non-safety-critical (file copying + part classification) and ships first.
